patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often containing content within a centered, constrained width container.
Card-based grid layouts are used for product categories and features, often featuring subtle drop shadows for depth.
A dual-font strategy employs a distinctive, elegant serif (NewKansas) for prominent headings and a clean, modern sans-serif (Roboto, Calibre) for body text and UI elements.
A deep navy blue serves as the primary brand color for navigation, footer, and key text, contrasted with soft pastel backgrounds (like a light pink hero) and crisp white content areas.
Sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content flow.
The primary navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport, maintaining its full height and dark blue background throughout the scroll.
Accordion-style elements are used for the Frequently Asked Questions section, allowing for concise content presentation.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience, likely using a scroll-triggered library.
The primary navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining its full height and background color throughout the scroll.
A horizontal carousel component, powered by Swiper, is used for browsing product categories, allowing users to swipe through options.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold serif headings (NewKansas) provide strong visual anchors, contrasted with clean, legible sans-serif body text (Roboto/Calibre) that is typically smaller and regular weight.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on card corners and button edges, with some larger content sections featuring a more pronounced corner radius.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and main content sections, transitioning to a more balanced density in product grids and the footer.

standout: The site effectively blends a sophisticated, editorial serif typeface for headings with clean, modern sans-serifs for body text, creating a unique brand voice that feels both established and approachable. The use of soft pastel hero backgrounds against a deep navy navigation also provides a distinctive color contrast.
